title: Aide personnalisée au logement (APL): eligibility by date, territory and applicant nationality

source.entry_point: Aides_logement scope ÉligibilitéAidePersonnaliséeLogement, output éligibilité (Python: generated.Aides_logement.eligibilite_aide_personnalisee_logement, Catala 1.3.0)

attributes.name: date_courante
attributes.source: ÉligibilitéAidePersonnaliséeLogement.date_courante (aides_logement/prologue.catala_fr:378-381). Cut points: smic/Smic.catala_fr:9-18 (brut_horaire has no definition before 2019-01-01); aides_logement/archives.catala_fr:11-16 (personnes_à_charge_prises_en_compte defined from 2019-09-01, counted at aides_logement/prologue.catala_fr:342-343); aides_logement/code_construction_legislatif.catala_fr:1333-1339 (L860-3: Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon excluded from 2021-01-01); smic/Smic.catala_fr:434-443 and 481-489 (two Mayotte SMIC definitions overlap from 2024-01-01 to 2024-10-31)

attributes.name: nationalite_demandeur
attributes.source: Demandeur.nationalité (aides_logement/prologue.catala_fr:228-247); read by L822-2 I (aides_logement/code_construction_legislatif.catala_fr:130-136) and its Mayotte version L861-5 1° (aides_logement/code_construction_legislatif.catala_fr:1389-1400)

every ménage and demandeur field that is.value: as in the official test Exemple1 (aides_logement/tests/tests_eligibilite_apl.catala_fr:16-107): date_courante |2020-03-10|, résidence Métropole, Mariés |2010-11-26|, three EnfantÀCharge (born 2001-01-01 Après with études, 2009-01-01 Pendant, 2012-01-01 Pendant; French, 0 € pay, no shared custody, a_déjà_ouvert_droit_aux_allocations_familiales vrai), prestations [AllocationSoutienEnfantHandicapé; ComplémentFamilial; AllocationsFamiliales], 1 other occupant, Locataire of a BailleurSocial conventionné (loyer 750 €, RLS 0 €, every other Location boolean faux, PasDeChangement), Zone1, résidence principale, décent, 80 m², propriétaire Autre, usufruit Autre, not let to third parties, no IFI, no unborn child, not R844-4; demandeur born 1970-05-02, Française, with every other boolean faux
every ménage and demandeur field that is.why: keeps the official test Exemple1 on the table; the other FR-APL tables vary these inputs

notes: Sub-table 1 of 5 of FR-APL (the APL eligibility decision split by subject; amount computation is out of scope).
